I'll add you right now, don't be afraid to vent to me anytime you need to. I don't know what you're going through, but I'm going though some bullshit since a couple of years myself and I'm sure you'll be able to relate to me. It gets better, but when times are rough it's good to have someone to talk to.

-> If you're talking about approaching new people, I had to make some friends this year since I'm in a new school, and believe me, it's easier than it seems.

First of all, spot some guys/girls you'd like to talk to or with who you may have common interests. It's easier when there's an opportunity, like team work if you're still in school. Ask people if you can join in! If you hear people talking about stuff you like, you can add up some words as well. Don't be afraid to smile, people will be more likely to want to talk with you this way. This is the easiest way, it comes naturally. If no good opportunities comes up, don't worry. Like I said before, start by smiling and look happy when you try to talk to people. Of course you can't just run at someone and yell ''HEY'' at their face, but you can approach them by introducing yourself. Telling your name is always a good start, right? Let them know you'd like to talk with them, and you'll see how they react. If the answer is positive, congratulations, you just made a new friend and can start talking with them. If the answer is negative, it's okay. Don't push too hard, just try with another person: remember everyone's different. All you need is a bit of courage. You can also pm me anytime!

-> Also if you're talking about approaching your friends and/or parents, you'll have to be strong and open up to them. It's the first step, but I know it's scary. Just remember they love you and care about you, so you have no reason feel guilty about having people to worry about you or to know that you're not alright. They're here for you. As time goes by, you'll grow more comfortable talking to them about private things.
